hooks.logic:
Let lastAbility be the last move of the enemy.
Let v3 be the main move id of lastAbility.
Let v4 be the first x in (the keys of data) where the id of the move labelled x on the enemy is v3.
If v4, then _ → each with (data at v4, given (x) { V → add-ability with (this state, {abilityTag: x, abilityOptions: {skipStepCnt: true}}). }, this state).
Otherwise, v → add-ability with (this state, {abilityId: the built-in move DO_NOTHING}).
